race.comment: Talented mare TALISAY (4) has not run a bad race for a long while. Chased hard but couldn't quite pick-up Air Assault in the Listed John Letts Cup over 1800m on 3 November. Finished fourth in this race last year carrying the same weight but she is going much better now. Gets her chance down on the limit. INEVITABLE AWARD (5) relished the step up in distance last time out when third-up from a very long spell, closing with purpose to get up for second over 2260m on the Parks track. Drops 2kgs and should be at his absolute peak. SUIT OF WANDS (6) scored a tearaway win here at this trip two back then led again last time but folded like a deck chair over a shorter journey. Milnes gets the best out of this fellow and she reunites so give him another chance. Classy stayer TIPPA (1) showed a glimpse of form last start when close up over 2260m at the Parks track. Good enough to test these. ARUGAMAMA (2) is over a year between drinks but is at her best over this course and distance.
